title: retry_approval_card input
description: Send a stuck approval card again, from the Admin page: a card that failed, or one sent more than two days ago with no answer, goes back to the approval runner. A request that was answered, expired or canceled meanwhile closes its card instead. Only a platform admin, in the web app. The audit trail records who asked.

approvalRecordId.description: The request whose card to send again, as the Admin page lists it.
